subject: Recap + Next Steps: AI Inference Pilot & Decision Plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ari Khan <ari.khan@edgewave.ai>, EdgeWave Sales <sales@edgewave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + Next Steps: AI Inference Pilot & Decision Plan

Hi Ari — thanks again for the productive conversation earlier. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Top pain points you confirmed
- Gen-quality regression when moving to heavier throughput (higher token dropouts + hallucination spikes).
- Unpredictable inference cost across bursty query patterns (weekend spikes and nightly batch jobs).
- Compliance need: audit logs and token retention policy for regulated workflows.

Stated goals (30–90 day horizon)
1) Validate parity on LLM outputs vs current vendor for 3 high-priority prompts.
2) Demonstrate 50% reduction in per-token serving cost with caching + batching.
3) Deliver an auditable configuration that meets your internal retention requirements.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (strawman milestones)
- Aug 29: Pilot kickoff — access + sample dataset exchange (EdgeWave engineers + Redwood eng contact)
- Sep 12: Head-to-head quality evaluation (3 prompts, metrics + qualitative notes)
- Sep 26: Performance & cost report; tuning recommendations and quantization proposal
- Oct 10: Exec review & procurement decision window; SOW + contract negotiation

Owners we discussed
- EdgeWave: Ari Khan (technical lead), Procurement (procurement@edgewave.ai)
- Redwood: Soojin Lee (sales lead), Ben Carter (solutions/eng), Monica Patel (security/compliance)

Action items for you
1) Confirm procurement contacts and required PO/legal timelines (procurement@edgewave.ai?)
2) Share a representative sample of the 3 prompts and 2 weeks of anonymized inference logs by Aug 26

I attached a one-sheet MAP with dates and owners for easy review (attachment: EdgeWave_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx [spreadsheet]). If those milestones look reasonable, I’ll lock calendar invites and put the test access instructions in a shared Drive folder.

Availability: I can run a 30-min handoff call with Ben and your infra lead next Wed (Aug 30) at 10am PT — does that work?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Subject: Re: Recap + Next Steps: AI Inference Pilot & Decision Plan

Soojin — thanks for the clear recap, this matches our notes. A few clarifications from my side:

- Procurement: yes, procurement@edgewave.ai is the right mailbox. My legal lead is Priya (cc’ed on procurement messages internally) — they typically need 4–6 weeks for enterprise SOW review but we can start that loop earlier.
- Decision process: Technical validation (my team) -> Security signoff (GRC) -> Procurement -> Executive approval. Our target decision checkpoint is the second week of October, aligning with your Oct 10 milestone.
- Pilot scope: we want Redwood Dedicated for the pilot (predictable throughput) and the caching recommendations you mentioned.

I reviewed the MAP you attached — the milestone cadence looks good. I’ll get the prompt samples and a redacted token log to you by Aug 26; if anything slips, I’ll flag it early.

Can we move the handoff call to Aug 31 at 9am PT? Ben’s availability looks tight on the 30th.

Thanks,
Ari
Ari Khan
Senior Product Manager, EdgeWave AI
ari.khan@edgewave.ai | +1 (206) 555-4421

Thanks for the heads-up. A couple quick internal asks before the handoff:

1) Soojin — can you prep a 1-page exec summary (two bullets on value + one slide equivalent cost delta) to drop in the Oct 10 exec packet? I’ll own the slide stitching.
2) Monica — once Ari confirms GRC evidence needs, can you list the items (SOC reports, retention config screenshots, logs export procedure) and an estimate for how long to compile them? That will help procurement set expectations.
3) Legal: once they want to view the SOW, we’ll need redline windows — propose we offer a 10-business-day review window but be ready to accelerate for big customers.

Soojin — I can join the Aug 31 call if you think it’s valuable; if not, Ben/solutions can run the technical workstream in the follow-up.
